dedupeText: textured portrait with script overlays portrait handwritten script chalkboard texture low key lighting sans serif typography blue and white text grunge background contrast between the smooth skin tones of the subject and the rough chalky texture of the background juxtaposition of messy organic handwriting in the background versus rigid geometric type in the foreground color link between the cool blue display text and the warm natural skin tones through complementary contrast combine a centered low key portrait with a textured script heavy background and anchor the composition with a two tier high contrast sans serif typographic block at the base

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up male portrait against a dark, textured background filled with layered, semi-transparent handwritten script. The subject wears a dark shirt that blends into the bottom of the frame, serving as a base for clean, blocky sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the smooth skin tones of the subject and the rough, chalky texture of the background.
Juxtaposition of messy, organic handwriting in the background versus rigid, geometric type in the foreground.
Color link between the cool blue display text and the warm, natural skin tones through complementary contrast.
coreInvariants: Layered cursive script overlays at varying angles
Two-tier sans-serif text block at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered head and shoulders portrait, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright blue display text at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves outward to the swirling background script, and settles on the bold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark, textured negative space around the head to emphasize the script and the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Charcoal black and deep grey (background and clothing).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast on the face; the blue text provides a singular pop of color.

letterConstructionRules: Condensed proportions for the primary line
Wide tracking for the secondary line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same-family or similar-style sans-serifs differentiated by color, scale, and tracking.
graphicDevices: Handwritten cursive script as a background texture

preserve: Condensed nature of the blue text
Wide tracking of the white text
avoid: Script fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold, uppercase look of the primary text.
Provides the clean, modern geometric feel required.
Excellent for the wide-tracked secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a young man with styled hair, wearing a black t-shirt, centered. The background should be a dark, charcoal-grey wall with heavy grunge texture. Overlay the background with multiple layers of semi-transparent, white and grey handwritten cursive script at various angles, avoiding the subject's face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text at the bottom. The top line should be in a bold, condensed sky-blue sans-serif font. The bottom line should be in a smaller, white sans-serif font with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the background script semi-transparent and layered?
Is the blue text condensed and bold?
Is the white text widely tracked?
Does the subject's shirt blend into the dark background?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the blue accent text
mustRedesign: Specific lyrics or words in the background script
Artist name and album title text
Specific facial features of the celebrity

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between portrait and text
avoid: Illegible overlapping of text and face
Comic or script fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script does not obscure the eyes.
Ensure the blue text is the primary visual anchor after the face.
Verify the texture looks like a physical surface (chalkboard/paper).
Confirm the two-tier text hierarchy is clear.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered, low-key portrait with a textured, script-heavy background and anchor the composition with a two-tier, high-contrast sans-serif typographic block at the base.
